title: Cancellation of a Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery Booking and Refund of Delivery Charges
content:
**Clause.** A Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery booking in scheduled status, the level's last status for a full-refund cancellation, can be cancelled at the customer's request or because its order is cancelled, and every charge billed on it is credited in full, with the credit given for the reason of a cancellation refund. Once the truck is dispatched the booking cannot be cancelled by the customer. A booking cancelled after failed attempts keeps its charges.

## Conditions and results

| Booking status | Cause of cancellation | Can it be cancelled? | Charges billed on the booking |
|---|---|---|---|
| Scheduled | The customer's request | Yes | Every charge credited in full |
| Scheduled | Its order is cancelled | Yes | Every charge credited in full |
| Out for delivery (truck dispatched) | The customer's request | Not by the customer | — |
| Cancelled after failed attempts | Attempts exhausted or storage hold expired | — | Kept |

## Points of judgement

- **What does the full credit cover?** Every charge billed on the booking: the base fee and any extra item, stairs, out-of-area, Saturday, haul-away, reschedule or redelivery charge that was billed on it.
- **Does the cause matter while the booking is scheduled?** Both causes, the customer's request and the cancellation of the order, lead to a full credit of every charge.
- **When does the customer lose the ability to cancel?** When the truck is dispatched and the booking goes out for delivery.

## Illustration (hypothetical booking)

A scheduled booking carries a base fee of $120.00, a stairs fee of $25.00 and a Saturday surcharge of $25.00, billed at booking, and a reschedule fee of $35.00 billed later. The customer asks to cancel while it is still scheduled. Each of the four charges is credited in full, $205.00 in all.
